title: Looking for a Flat
sentences: We are looking for a bigger flat near the city.
Our flat now has only one bedroom.
The baby will need her own room next year.
We looked at three places last weekend.
The first one was bright but very expensive.
The second was cheap and quite dark.
The third had a small balcony and a good kitchen.
It is farther from my office, so I would take the train.
We are thinking about the third one.
We must decide before the end of the month.
